Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

According to the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is aggrieved by the non- disposal of his application filed on 31.12.2022 under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 pending before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar,
Nuapada (opposite party no.3) in which notice had been issued to him for appearance on 12.11.2024.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In such background, he prays that a direction be issued to the opposite party no.3 to dispose of the said case expeditiously.

Considering the submission made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court disposes of the writ petition directing the opposite party no.3 to dispose of the application of the petitioner filed under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order and to Harihar Majhi @ Hari vs State Of Odisha And ....
